# `regexp_extract`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Extract the first string in the `str` that match the `regexp`
expression and corresponding to the regex group index.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
regexp_extract(str, regexp[, idx])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- regexp_extract, example 1
> SELECT regexp_extract('100-200', '(\\d+)-(\\d+)', 1);
100
```

```sql
-- regexp_extract, example 2
> SELECT regexp_extract('100-200', r'(\d+)-(\d+)', 1);
100
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
